text:
So funny new lore about the Tamers MLP universe. That is a First Alert BRK smoke detector wired in model, which has a low battery beep interval of 30 to 60 seconds. In this it has a constant beeping of 10 seconds intervals , which means that the time in this universe is actually faster. Which could mean a handful of things, such as a lower gravitational pull or just less mass in general meaning the planet could be smaller. But that would mean that the time between 7:55 and 8:05 at the earliest when there is a long stretch of conversation and no cut away, that in their universe would've taken a whole minute or 30 seconds on the low end. In other words This whole 22 minute and 51 second long video would break down to 1,371 seconds. If we take the fact that with the current knowledge that their speed is 6x the speed of our planet that means this video would be 8,226 seconds if they were to watch it. Which would mean it would take roughly 137.1 minutes or 2.285 hours. or like 2 hours, 17 minutes, 6 seconds.

Source: I have that same smoke detector.

text:
Damn, when I said last vid that Braeburn and Soarin's exile was finally starting to affect the equestrian citizenry with how long they'd gone without their primary form of resurrection (climbing out of holes in the ground to escape from hell), I wasn't expecting that Celestia would actually bite the bullet and let the stallions back in.

That's character growth right there.
...ooooor her waning power forcing her to let not-explicitly-genocidal alicorns back into this reality so Equestria only sort-of collapses when she retires.

Pointing that out to her face might make her do takesies-backsies out of spite, tho, so let's just say it's the growth and eternal mercy option.


Anyways I think spitfire might actually be my favorite character; exposing hidden corrupt redlining only to then reveal she'll be up keeping the tradition is exactly the kinda racist caracature you can't help but fall madly involved with, create a tulpa of, and then get beaten up by said tulpa for~ ❤️❤️❤️


I really love that Soarin just has this hope in his heart that cannot be crushed, because it's so funny to see it abused over and over again to hurt him... Only for him to turn that heart around and use it to hurt those same ponies in the ways that actually matter.

The tamersverse ironically has a real chance of turning around pony racism, unlike the actual main MLP timeline, where twilight was such an utter failure as the princess of magic that the ponies started inter-racial tensions again after literally only a few years of Celestia's retirement. Not even a full generation just a few years and it was all relearned.

(Especially if he keeps pulling medieval level fabrication claims like that, go off gurl, fraudulently steal that crown.)
